title: Lusha vs Seamless.AI — Jon Martin
seoTitle: Lusha vs Seamless.AI for HubSpot Teams
description: Lusha and Seamless.AI compared for small sales teams on HubSpot: free plans, paid pricing, credits per contact, and how each pushes data to HubSpot.
dek: Two contact data tools compared for a small team that wants emails and phone numbers to land cleanly in HubSpot.
Prices and features below come from each vendor's own pages, checked on the date shown. Both links are affiliate links.

blocks.html: This comparison is for a founder or a small sales team that needs contact data, emails and direct dials, for prospects tracked in HubSpot, and is weighing Lusha against Seamless.AI.
Both sell credits that unlock contact details. They differ in how they price, how a credit is spent, and how records reach HubSpot.

Choose Lusha if you want to see the price, buy a small plan, and start today. Choose Seamless.AI if you'll use a lot of credits each month and want contacts saved to HubSpot automatically, and you're fine getting a quote.
Start both on their free plans, look up the same twenty prospects, and compare hit rates before you pay for either.

Lusha has a Free plan with up to 40 credits a month, CRM integrations included. Starter is $49.90 a month billed monthly, with 400 credits a month, or $37.45 a month billed annually ($449.10 a year). Pro is $69.90 a month billed monthly, with 600 credits a month. Credits work like this: 1 credit to reveal an email and 5 credits to reveal a phone number. Note that teams larger than 5 users go through sales.

Lusha pushes contacts and companies into HubSpot with field mapping, and checks for existing records first so you don't create duplicates. Per Lusha, setup needs admin access on both Lusha and HubSpot.

Seamless.AI has a free plan with 50 credits and no credit card. Beyond that, paid plans are quoted per company, with no fixed public price. Credit allowances run from 250 credits per user per month on a Basic license to 10,000 credits per user per month on a Pro license. Credits are spent as 1 credit for an email, 5 for a phone number, or 6 for the full contact.
Seamless.AI imports contacts and companies into HubSpot one at a time, in bulk, or automatically when you save them. Per Seamless.AI, every user who connects needs App Marketplace Access in HubSpot.
Phone numbers cost more credits than emails on both tools, so decide whether your team calls or emails first. A calling team burns credits much faster.
If you need a budget number this week, Lusha's public prices make that easy. If you expect heavy monthly volume, Seamless.AI's larger credit pools may work out cheaper once quoted.
Lusha routes larger teams to sales, so the public prices only go so far.
Seamless.AI has no public paid price, so you can't compare costs without a sales call.
Test both on the same list, and check how each one handles a contact that already exists in HubSpot. Duplicates are the most common cleanup job after an enrichment tool goes live.
Then price the plan for the credits you used in the test, multiplied out over a month.
